# narration subject

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:narrationSubject`](gmeow-narrationSubject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/narrationSubject>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)

The narrated diegetic entity, event, or situation. Range intentionally open (the narrates convention). Functional and mandatory (SHACL): one relator per (segment, subject) pair — a chapter narrating four events with modes is four NarrationUsages.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NarrationUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NarrationUsage.md) -> `?`; functional
